name: portfolio-website
description: Personal portfolio website built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Node.js

scripts.optimize-images: node optimize-images.js && cp -r client/src/assets client/src/assets-backup && cp -r client/src/assets-optimized/* client/src/assets/ && echo 'Images optimized and replaced in assets folder'
scripts.restore-images: cp -r client/src/assets-backup/* client/src/assets/ && echo 'Original images restored'
scripts.build: npm run optimize-images && cd client && npm install && CI=false npm run build
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
